user_amendments: Preserve main layout and consolidate tests and metadata.
Tenant IDs join run, arm and episode IDs as opaque UUIDs; require explicit migration, without aliases.
World labels are descriptive metadata; host-minted persisted world UUIDs name all world artifacts, removing label-derived filename bounds. Family judge draws have an episode-level namespace.

Arm rosters and internal identity joins use persisted world UUIDs. A shared reader/publication byte budget is enforced before family publication and preflight; one trace classifier supplies rendering and unattributed reporting.
